title: S corporation basis and losses — Theo Marsh
instructions: Theo Marsh owns 100% of Quill Inc., an S corporation. Compute his allowable loss and basis.

exhibits.title: Year 1
exhibits.content:
Beginning stock basis: **$10,000**; Theo's loan to Quill (debt basis): **$15,000**.
Quill's Year 1 items: ordinary loss **$30,000**; §1231 gain **$2,000**; tax-exempt interest **$1,000**; cash distribution to Theo **$4,000**.

exhibits.title: Year 2
exhibits.content: Quill has ordinary income of **$12,000** and makes no distributions.

rows.label: Stock basis available for the Year 1 loss
Debt basis at the end of Year 2
rows.explanation: Income restores debt basis first (12,000), then the 6,000 suspended loss is used: **6,000**.

rows.label: Stock basis at the end of Year 2
rows.explanation: Debt basis must be restored before stock basis: **0**.
